description: Variation of ref: 21/03694/FUL condition number 1 to be amended as follows: This permission shall be for a limited period of 3 years only, expiring on 31/01/2028. Following this date, the building and any enabling development (excluding the car parking and training pitch) shall be removed from the site and the land shall be reinstated to an open landscape and thereafter be retained as such.
decision_conditions: No plant equipment, plumbing, pipes, or relocated services and fittings shall be fixed on the external elevation of the temporary buildings unless expressly shown on the approved plans listed in Condition 2 of the planning permission .Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance to the development having regard its sensitive location and the surrounding Green Belt

This permission shall be for a limited period of 3 years only, expiring on 31/01/2028 . Post three years of the temporary permission, the building and any enabling development (excluding the car parking and training pitch) shall be removed from the site and the land shall be reinstated to an open landscape and thereafter be retained as such.Reason: To enable the Local Planning Authority to review the suitability of the development in the light of circumstances prevailing at the end of the above period and in the interests of the amenities of the area, in accordance with Chapter 13 of the NPPF (2021), Policy G2 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DMD82 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The retrospective temporary building hereby approved shall be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved plans and documents (listed below) for the duration of the planning permission. The existing buildings and structures forming part of this development  shall be retained in their existing external appearance Reason: in the interests of safeguarding the visual amenities and character of the area

The hereby approved lighting shall be implemented in accordance with approved plan (reference 20-GA-107 Rev P2) and light from the floodlights is not to exceed 10 EV(lux) when measured from Archers Wood to the south. All floodlights shall be oriented and designed in such a way to minimise light spillage beyond the site boundary and prevent glare to Archers wood.Reason: In the interests of safeguarding ecological and biodiversity of the adjoining woodland and the wider rural setting of the site.

The hereby approved development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Drainage Strategy and associated plans (ref: Surface Water Management note (Ref 2117 dated September 2021).Reason: in the interests of managing surface water and  preventing localised flooding

The hereby approved temporary building shall be constructed to the standards provided in the Energy and Sustainability Report (Ref JPE-2127)Reason: To ensure carbon efficiency and comply with relevant adopted policy

Written confirmation shall be submitted to the local planning authority within 1 month of the date of the decision notice, confirming the hereby approved covered cycle parking facilities are provided on site. The covered cycle parking facilities shall thereafter be permanently maintained and made available for cycle parking.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking spaces in line with the Council's adopted standards

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 as amended by Regulations 2020, Town & Country Planning Use Classes (Amendment) (England) (No. 2) Regulations 2020 and the Town & Country Planning Use Classes (Amendment) (England) (No. 3) Regulations 2020, the use of the temporary building hereby approved shall be restricted to only useas a football training facility directly linked to THFC, as a Sui generis use and no other useReason: To ensure the use does not adversely impact on the residential amenities of the area and the character of the locality .

Operating hours for the temporary training facility hereby approved shall be restricted to operational hours of 6am to Midnight daily:Reason: To ensure the use and associated lights do not adversely impact on the neighbouring residential element of the development
